state: Reference Price UP + CVD DOWN + OI UP; execution tape roughly flat
path_note: After the prior buyer-failure/deleveraging transition, CVD rolled lower again while OI rebuilt. The reference chart price improved modestly from ~78.23k to ~78.345k, but the execution tape remained roughly flat and price stayed below dVAL/dOpen/dPOC. This preserves the leveraged-sell-absorption signature on the reference series, but structural confirmation is still missing.
interpretation: Aggressive selling increased while open leverage expanded, yet the reference price did not make a new low and instead improved slightly. That is constructive absorption behavior, not simple bearish leverage expansion. However, because the execution tape is nearly flat and reference price remains below value, the signal is not strong enough for an automatic long. OI rising does not prove new shorts; it only shows leverage returning.

long_scenario.second_trigger: Reclaim dPOC/dOpen ~78,550-78,565 and hold/retest from above.

lesson: After a prolonged deleveraging phase, Price UP + CVD DOWN + OI UP can reappear before value is reclaimed. Treat this as leveraged sell absorption below value, not a completed reversal. Structural confirmation still has priority: dVAL first, then dPOC/dOpen, then dVAH. Cross-instrument disagreement lowers confidence and must be preserved rather than averaged away.
